description: This file contains Python source code implementing a JSON schema parser and loader, including classes for JSON types, objects, arrays, methods, and schema processing functions.

classes.name: JsonType
classes.description: Base class representing a JSON schema type with properties for name, description, and type-specific attributes.

classes.name: JsonNull
classes.description: Represents a JSON null type.

classes.name: JsonBoolean
classes.description: Represents a JSON boolean type.

classes.name: JsonInteger
classes.description: Represents a JSON integer type with size and sign attributes.

classes.name: AuxJsonInteger
classes.description: Generated auxiliary JSON integer type.

classes.name: AuxJsonAuto
classes.description: Generated auxiliary JSON auto type.

classes.name: JsonNumber
classes.description: Represents a JSON floating point number with size attribute.

classes.name: JsonString
classes.description: Represents a JSON string type.

classes.name: JsonInstanceId
classes.description: Represents a JSON instance ID type.

classes.name: JsonRefCounted
classes.description: Provides reference counting for JSON objects.

classes.name: JsonTime
classes.description: Represents a JSON time type with format conversion methods.

classes.name: JsonMacAddress
classes.description: Represents a MAC address type in JSON.

classes.name: JsonEnum
classes.description: Represents a JSON enum type with size and enumerator details.

classes.name: JsonObject
classes.description: Represents a JSON object with properties, nested objects, and enums.

classes.name: JsonArray
classes.description: Represents a JSON array with item type.

classes.name: JsonMethod
classes.description: Represents a JSON method with parameters, result, and associated metadata.

classes.name: JsonNotification
classes.description: Represents a JSON notification message.

classes.name: JsonCallback
classes.description: Represents a callback associated with a notification.

classes.name: JsonProperty
classes.description: Represents a property within a JSON object.

classes.name: JsonRpcSchema
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC schema with methods, info, and include handling.

methods.name: Tstring
methods.description: Returns a string formatted with '_T()' macro.

methods.name: Scoped
methods.description: Generates a scoped name for a JSON object or type based on hierarchy.

methods.name: CoreJson
methods.description: Constructs a core JSON type string with prefix.

methods.name: MakeObject
methods.description: Creates an object type name with suffix.

methods.name: MakeEnum
methods.description: Creates an enum type name with suffix.

methods.name: LoadSchema
methods.description: Loads and processes a JSON schema file, resolving references and includes.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Main entry point to load schemas from a file path, handling headers and JSON schemas.
